lines.en: Do not hurry me; my hooves are stuck in the mud.

lines.zh: 最稳的步子，一直是我的。
lines.en: The steadiest steps have always been mine.
The grass is east, and the sun is west.
Wet mud is packed between my hooves.
Tired of walking, so I nibble.

lines.zh: 我在泥里走，没留下脚印。
lines.en: I walk the mud without leaving prints.

lines.zh: 谁把我啃过的草踩平了？
lines.en: Who trampled the grass I was nibbling?
Which swamp am I walking to today?

lines.zh: 我从没有自然生成的地方来。
lines.en: I come from nowhere that spawns me.
I have stepped in every one of these mud pools.
Head down for moss, I shuffle along.
I know the damp of woodland.
I step to the swamp's water sound.
A shadow walks without legs.

lines.zh: 别踩我投在泥上的影子。
lines.en: Do not step on my shadow in the mud.
I circle my own shadow.
A marsh shadow walks with you.
I remember a little, then forget again.
Which clump of grass was I going to nibble?

lines.zh: 盯着泥潭发呆，一上午过去了。
lines.en: I stare at the mud pool and the morning is gone.

lines.zh: 风里有湿苔和腐叶的味。
lines.en: The wind carries wet moss and rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 沼泽安静得只剩我的呼吸。
lines.en: The swamp is so quiet only my breathing remains.
Who is calling me from the mud? A frog.

lines.zh: 这片树影正合我的毛色。
lines.en: This tree shade matches my coat exactly.

lines.zh: 一只萤虫停在我的角尖。
lines.en: A firefly has settled on the tip of my antler.
Did I forget to hide from the sun?

lines.zh: 我站着，可我看不出自己的影子。
lines.en: I stand here, yet I cannot find my own shadow.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，把我的脚粘住了。
lines.en: The swamp mud has stuck my feet.

lines.zh: 站在阴影里，谁也看不见。
lines.en: Standing in the shade, no one can see me.
The cloud has passed, but the shadow remains.
Shh, I am listening to the swamp bubble.
I can't even be bothered to move my shadow.

lines.zh: 别突然靠这么近，我还没显形。
lines.en: Do not come so close; I am not manifest yet.

lines.zh: 你拨开芦苇找我做什么？
lines.en: Why did you part the reeds to find me?

lines.zh: 你手里那束草是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that bunch of grass for me?

lines.zh: 沼泽水面上，我的影子先到。
lines.en: On the swamp water my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和火把的味。
lines.en: You smell of iron and torch smoke.
You have come to muddy my water again.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着青草味的袋子。
lines.en: A bag of grass scent hangs at your waist.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩断了我藏的枯枝。
lines.en: Your boots snapped the dry branch I was hiding.

lines.zh: 黑森林的影子里，我等你。
lines.en: In the dark forest shade, I wait.

lines.zh: 看什么，这里没有你要的鹿茸。
lines.en: What are you looking at? There is no antler velvet here.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾里，我不太成形。
lines.en: In the swamp fog I hardly hold shape.

lines.zh: 你第一次进这片沼泽吧？
lines.en: Is this your first time in this swamp?
It is only a small piece of shadow missing.
Can my front hooves still touch the ground?

lines.zh: 别趁我疼的时候凑过来。
lines.en: Don't come close while I'm hurting.
Who kicked my hind leg? Come out.
A shadow cannot cry; it only retreats.

lines.zh: 谁踩了我藏在泥里的角？
lines.en: Who stepped on my antler hidden in the mud?

lines.zh: 我是影子，伤了也看不出。
lines.en: I'm a shadow — wounds don't show.

lines.zh: 我要退回那棵老树的影子里。
lines.en: I need to retreat into that old tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 我的声音，从泥里传出来。
lines.en: My voice rises out of the mud.
My antlers will remember this score.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥味里，分我一口。
lines.en: Out of this swamp-smell, share one bite.

lines.zh: 沼泽里没谁给过我东西。
lines.en: Nobody in the bog ever gave me anything.
My nose turns wherever you go.
That bunch of moss in your hand smells lovely.

lines.zh: 看见你之后，我才觉得饿。
lines.en: Only after seeing you did I feel hungry.

lines.zh: 阴影里的味道，让我发软。
lines.en: The smell in the shadow makes me weak.

lines.zh: 我的影子里，伸出一只手。
lines.en: A hand reaches out of my shadow.
This leaf is tenderer than the swamp grass.

lines.zh: 你上次也带了这种东西。
lines.en: You brought this thing last time too.

lines.zh: 影子一样的东西，也会饿。
lines.en: Even a shadow gets hungry.

lines.zh: 举那么高，我这影子够不着。
lines.en: Hold it that high and this shadow can't reach.

lines.zh: 我没有影子，只能跟着你的。
lines.en: I have no shadow; I borrow yours.
You hold the grass, and I will follow.

lines.zh: 把苔藓放地上，我自己来。
lines.en: Set the moss down and I'll come to it.
In the shadow, my drool drips first.
Moss! I am coming over!
Which mud flat are you rushing to?
Did it hurt when you hit my antlers?

lines.zh: 我没有群系可生成，只站着。
lines.en: No biome spawns me. I just stand.
I am not hungry today, so I will let it go.
Do not push; I am only a shadow.
A quick feel. Ribs are still there.

lines.zh: 沼泽的小路容不下我们俩。
lines.en: This swamp path cannot fit both of us.
I am a shadow, yet I leave hoofprints.

lines.zh: 我只是个影子，没有刷怪蛋。
lines.en: I'm only a shadow, without a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 沼泥上的影，踩下去是软的。
lines.en: A shadow on bog mud—soft underfoot.

lines.zh: 影子靠着影子，就够暖了。
lines.en: Shadow against shadow is warmth enough.
Do not fear; my hooves are light.

lines.zh: 我藏在你影子里等你回来。
lines.en: I'll hide in your shadow till you come back.
My chest is pounding hard enough to burst.

lines.zh: 你的角靠过来，影子就合了。
lines.en: Your antlers lean in, and our shadows merge.
The swamp water shows us both.
Come closer. Shadows aren't cold.
Even a shadow wants company.
This shadow is only half a body wide.

lines.zh: 从涨水的春天我就跟着你。
lines.en: I have followed you since the flooded spring.
I can carry it in my mouth, do not worry.
This piece of bark is too hard to chew.
One more thing hangs from my antlers.
Taking this back for the little ones.
Did this fall out of your bag?

lines.zh: 沼泽里捡的东西，我先含着。
lines.en: I'll hold what I found in the marsh.
I tuck it into the fur on my neck.
This is better than the branch I grind my antlers on.

lines.zh: 我从泥里捡起一块亮片。
lines.en: I pick a bright fleck out of the mud.
This mushroom is wet. Is it edible?

lines.zh: 我的角尖正对着你的方向。
lines.en: My antler tips point your way.

lines.zh: 我这张影子脸，看不清吧。
lines.en: You can't make out my shadow face.

lines.zh: 你身后的树影动了一下。
lines.en: The shadow behind you just moved.

lines.zh: 那一丛草被啃了，我记得位置。
lines.en: That clump was chewed; I know the spot.

lines.zh: 泥面下的线，你一踩就断。
lines.en: One step snaps the line under the mud.

lines.zh: 你踩坏的那丛苔，我记着。
lines.en: I remember the moss patch you trampled.

lines.zh: 那丛苔藓是我先看见的。
lines.en: I saw that moss first.
The brood is my charge.
Take one more step into my mud pool and see.
The trough is mine; keep your hands off.
You go around the tree, and I go around your shadow.
Do not make me run through the mud.
A swamp shadow follows the water.
I'm just a sodden patch of shade.
My antlers have always been in the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 你的汗味在沼泽里很冲。
lines.en: Your sweat cuts sharply through the swamp.
In the mud, footprints don't lie.
I will circle around behind the reeds.

lines.zh: 我只要你退出这片泥地。
lines.en: I only want you to leave this mud flat.
Wait, there are broken shells in the mud.
I only meant to stay by the water.
See? Hooves work better than teeth.
Do not dodge; take my antler charge.
Leave my tree shadow, and I will stop.

lines.zh: 我的角比沼泽的树根硬。
lines.en: My antlers are harder than swamp roots.

lines.zh: 这一下是替被惊走的幼崽。
lines.en: This one is for the fawn you scared off.
No horns, no hooves on me.

lines.zh: 别怪我，你踏进了我的泥洼。
lines.en: Do not blame me; you stepped into my mud pool.
A claw reaching out of the shadow.
Just one shove. Don't dodge.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽没有我的名字。
lines.en: This swamp has no name for me.
From today on, I move an inch at a time.
I remember the color of this mud.

lines.zh: 泥太软，我的蹄子陷进去了。
lines.en: The mud is too soft; my hooves are sinking.
Is this woodland? The soil feels wrong.
This mud smells familiar, like home.
Out of the mud, that's me.
A shadow's first sound comes out muffled.

lines.zh: 芦苇里还有别的影子吗？
lines.en: Are there other shadows in the reeds?

lines.zh: 阳光太亮，我得躲进树影。
lines.en: The sunlight is too bright; I must hide in the tree shade.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的影子就淡了。
lines.en: One flame and my shadow thins out.

lines.zh: 从这么高的枝上摔下来……
lines.en: Falling from a branch this high...

lines.zh: 沼泽的水没过了我的脖子！
lines.en: The swamp water is up to my neck!
Mud was blasted into the air.

lines.zh: 一根箭钉进了我的肩胛。
lines.en: An arrow has pinned my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 那些词让我的影子发抖。
lines.en: Those words make my shadow tremble.
I have nibbled all the grass in this swamp.

lines.zh: 雷照出我的影子，所以劈我？
lines.en: Did the lightning strike me because it showed my shadow?
There is no moss to nibble in the void.
